decisions.decision: Town Manager to consult with Town Counsel regarding valid funding sources for Article 3 pending certification of free cash
decisions.quote: town manager warren-dyment explained that the article that was received stated certified free cash or available funds. while free cash will not be certified by the special town meeting, she has asked town counsel about what funds may be in scope. since town counsel has not yet replied town manager warren-dyment did not want to comment publicly but there may be other funding options.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Article 1 submitted by School Department to raise and appropriate an additional sum for FY27 operating budget
budget_items.quote: article 1 (submitted by the school department) is to raise and appropriate an additional sum of $418,056 for the fy27 operating budget for the school department or take any other action relative thereto.

budget_items.topic: FY27 School Department Operating Budget Supplement
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Article 2 submitted by citizen petition to raise and appropriate or transfer from available funds to supplement school budget with unspecified amount
budget_items.quote: article 2 (submitted by citizen petition) is to see if the town will vote to raise and appropriate or transfer from available funds a sum of money to supplement the school department's fy27 operating budget or take any other action relative thereto.

budget_items.topic: FY27 School Athletic Department and Student Transportation
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Article 3 submitted by citizen petition to transfer funds for athletic department to reinstate middle school sports and provide student transportation
budget_items.quote: article 3 (submitted by citizen petition) to see if the town will vote to transfer a sum of money in the amount of 151,338.38 from certified free cash or available funds to the lunenberg public schools fy27 operating budget for the purpose of supplementing the athletic department budget to reinstate middle school sports as well as provide transportation for student athletes or take any other action relative thereto.

transfers.description: Transfer from certified free cash or available funds to Lunenberg Public Schools FY27 operating budget for athletic department and student transportation
